**irr 50（2026-08-20・irr=70 の二重読み。v9.9.144 の5点検問）**　『Our sales process to new and existing customers usually involves: demonstrations and testing against industry benchmarks in our sales centers; sales and technical presentations and presentations regarding our products’ competitive advantages; and installation of the systems at the customer’s site for side-by-side competitive evaluations for a period of approximately six months.』（Item 3.D Risk Factors「A longer sales process for new products may increase our costs and delay time to market of our products...」直下）——**新規・既存の両方**の顧客に競合機との並列評価を課す＝毎回コンペ。移行障壁の反対の事実を会社自身が述べている　『A longer sales process for new products may increase our costs and delay time to market of our products, both of which may negatively impact our revenues, results of operations, cash flow and may result in inventory write-offs.』（Item 3.D Risk Factors（上記段落の見出し））——機構文の置き場所と向き。この摩擦は当社を害するものとして枠づけられており、当社を守る障壁として書かれていない　『We typically operate with limited visibility and do not have long-term purchase commitments with many customers.』（Item 3.D Risk Factors（AIダウンサイクルの予見性））——複数年の購買義務を会社が明示的に否定（検問4）　『The markets we serve are highly competitive and have significant global market participants, some with greater resources than us.』（Item 3.D Risk Factors）——規約上70の根拠にならない語であり、かつ移行障壁の記述が代わりに存在しないことの傍証　《反証（同じ原本に同居する）》『As of December 31, 2025, our installed base was over 3,000 systems.』 ／ 『the selling cycle in our markets typically takes several quarters from first contact to revenue recognition, including on-site evaluation. Naturally, repeat orders take less time.』 ／ 『since these circumstances usually require qualification of the systems by the customers and engineering efforts to fix errors, customize tasks and add new features.』　《射程》全社。2025年の最大顧客は総売上の11%で、単一顧客への集中も無い。設置基盤3,000台は開示されるが、そこに紐づく顧客側の費用・義務の記述が一つも無い。　《検問と反証の経緯》【70を支える文を探した経緯（実数つき）】20-F 504,199字を走査: switching cost 0 / switch 0 / multi-year 0 / long-term agreement 0 / long-term contract 0 / consumable 0 / copy exact 0 / process of record 0 / design-in 0 / designed into 0 / re-qualif 0 / requalif 0 / recertif 0 / displac 0 / incumbent 0 / 'maintains that selection' 0。'qualif' は49件あるが、業務機構に関わるのは3件だけで、残りは取締役の資格要件（イスラエル会社法）・qualified institutional buyers（144A）・qualified dividend（税務）・qualified personnel（採用）・『qualified in its entirety by reference』・Industrial Company の税務適格。'installed base' 1件、'barrier' 1件（trade barriers＝関税）。
【★決定打は候補文そのものだった】台帳の旧根拠に続く同じ段落を読むと『Our sales process to new and existing customers usually involves: ... installation of the systems at the customer's site for side-by-side competitive evaluations for a period of approximately six months.』——**新規だけでなく既存顧客にも**、競合機と並べた6ヶ月の実機評価を行うと会社自身が書いている。これは移行障壁ではなく、既存顧客でも毎回コンペになるという反対の事実。しかもこの段落が載る直前のリスク見出しは『A longer sales process for new products may increase our costs and delay time to market of our products...』＝摩擦が守るのではなく**当社を害する**という枠組み（ALOT/SPR/TGIで確立した『機構文はリスク要因の中にあり見出しが逆を言う』型）。
【他の候補も落ちた】'installed base was over 3,000 systems' は数字はあるが顧客が負う費用・時間・義務を一言も述べない（RMD型）。'repeat orders take less time' は当社の収益認識タイミングの説明で、顧客側の費用ではない。qualification の3件も『timing of evaluation and qualification of our products by new customers』＝新規顧客の話と、四半期変動要因の列挙。'single source' 1件は当社の**仕入先**が単一という当社の供給リスク（検問3(2)・向きが逆）。
【反証】『We typically operate with limited visibility and do not have long-term purchase commitments with many customers』＝複数年の購買義務を会社が明示的に否定。『The markets we serve are highly competitive』（規約上70の根拠にならない）＋『may attract and result in new market entrants』＋『Competition could result in lower prices for our products』。
【evidence_gap】台帳の旧根拠『selling cycle ... several quarters ... including on-site evaluation. Naturally, repeat orders take less time』は当社の販売サイクルの記述であって顧客の移行費用ではなく、同じ原本が既存顧客にも side-by-side 競合評価を課すと書いているため、70を積極的に支えていない。
